modules.name: Cycle Clock
modules.description: A clock that counts a whole rhythm cycle, such as a 16-beat thalam or a 7/8 bar, and tells you where you are in it.
modules.keywords: thalam tala taal talam rhythm cycle bar meter polymetre hindustani carnatic tintal adi beat counter

modules.name: R&T
modules.description: R&T (Rhythm & Thalam) splits every beat into 1 to 9 equal parts, the way Carnatic music counts nadai (also called gati). Divide the parts by 1 to 64, and drop some by chance.
modules.keywords: nadai gati tuplet triplet quintuplet septuplet clock divider subdivision polyrhythm rhythm thalam tala carnatic probability
